name: PVR Inox Ltd
title: PVR Inox Ltd - 532689 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: PVR INOX shifted to capital-light expansion with net debt cut to INR161 crores and FY26 FCF of INR790 crores; FY27 capex guided INR375-400 crores, 120+ screens planned, occupancy 26.2% FY26.

utilisation.quote: 26.2% is what we closed the year on.

capex.quote: we expect around INR375 crores to INR400 crores of overall capex

triggers.label: Capex intensity down 24% YoY
triggers.quote: Capex intensity is down 24% year-on-year basis.

triggers.label: Net debt INR161 crores; gross debt to INR500 crores
triggers.quote: we want to bring it down to about INR500 crores levels at a gross debt.

triggers.label: ATP up 8%, SPH up 10% in FY26
triggers.quote: ATP for the year stood at INR280, which is up by 8% compared to previous year

guidance.quote: Expansion will be continuing to be over 100 screens.
we expect around INR375 crores to INR400 crores of overall capex
It will continue to be between 55% to 60%.
we intend to bring it down to about INR500 crores levels
we're hoping to open close to 28 to 30 screens under this model.

red_flags.label: Advertising growth subdued; slowest revenue stream
red_flags.quote: advertising seems to have been the slowest growth.

red_flags.label: Buyback question deflected
red_flags.quote: At this stage, yes, it is definitely one of the things which is there in the list. But at this stage, we don't have any incremental guidance to offer.

evasions.quote: At this stage, yes, it is definitely one of the things which is there in the list.
At this stage, it's hard for us to give a guidance on what exact percentage drop that will happen
